fields.label: Description
fields.value: Promotional poster for an exhibition titled, Art from the Black Community which was presented in conjunction with the Laguna Beach Art Association annual membership show. The flyer includes a list of artists from the greater Los Angeles area and is printed in black and white on glossy paper. Ankrum and Brockman Gallery's assistance is acknowledged in addition to noting that this was Orange County's first exposure to contemporary black culture.

ART from

the BLACK COMMUNITY

an invitational exhibition
in conjunction with the
LAGUNA BEACH ART ASSOCIATION
ANNUAL MEMBERSHIP SHOW

307 Cliff Drive

Laguna Beach, California

SEPTEMBER 3rd to SEPTEMBER 29th

OPENING
Cocktail Reception for the Artists
Sunday, September 8th -3:00 to 5:00 p. m.

PAINTINGS, GRAPHICS,

CONSTRUCTIONS, CERAMICS, SCULPTURE

. . . all works will be on sale . ..

the printing of this brochure made possible
by anonymous donator of
UNITARIAN UNIVERSALIST FELLOWSHIP,
LAGUNA BEACH

artists from the greater Los Angeles area:

DAN CONCHOLAR, Chairman

GEORGE CLACK

DALE DAVIS

ALANZO DAVIS

DAVID HAMMONS

SUZANNE JACKSON

KENNETH KEMP

SEMELA LEWIS

JOHN OUTTERBRIDGE

MICHAEL PERRY

BILL PAJAUD

An Orange County's first exposure to contem-
porary black culture cries: "The world is a con-
fused and fearful place, that God is difficult to
find, that our philosophical systems are imper-
fect, that the only hope is communication be-
tween individuals ... " [reprinted from Watt's
"66 Signs of Neon"]

FOR: "Art is not done to decorate the walls of apartments,
but as a tool against war and brutality."
(Picasso)
we acknowledge the assistance of
ANKRUM and BROCKMAN GALLERIES
